questions.prompt: Two angles on a straight line are 2x and x. What is x?
questions.explanation: 2x + x = 180, so 3x = 180 and x = 60. 120° is the size of the angle 2x, not x itself.

questions.prompt: Three angles at a point are 140°, 85° and a. What is a?
questions.explanation: Angles at a point add up to 360°: 140 + 85 = 225 and 360 - 225 = 135. 225 is only the sum of the two you know.

questions.prompt: Two straight lines cross. One angle is 72°. What is the vertically opposite angle?
questions.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are equal. 108° is the angle next to it on the straight line.

questions.prompt: A transversal crosses two parallel lines. One angle is 56°. What is its corresponding angle?
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles (the F shape) are equal. 124° would be the co-interior angle.

questions.prompt: Two co-interior angles between parallel lines are 112° and y. What is y?
questions.explanation: Co-interior angles add up to 180°: 180 - 112 = 68. They are not equal, and 248 comes from using 360.

questions.prompt: Which pair of angles on parallel lines is NOT equal?
questions.explanation: Co-interior angles add up to 180°. Alternate and corresponding angles are equal.
